decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the garage is used as a habitable room.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the habitable room hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 5 - The planting beds shown on drawing number 059/M/2003 shall be ilaid out prior the use of the garage as a habitable room and the use of the parking layout hereby permitted, and shall be permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 6 - A boundary wall of no higher than 0.6m shall be reinstated along the front boundary of the site prior the use of the habitable room and parking layout hereby permitted. The wall shall be constructed in bricks reclaimed from the original front wall and shall measure 3m wide when taken from the side boundary with number 19 Shelley Crescent.

Condition : 7 - The habitable room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the single-family dwelling known as 21 Shelley Crescent and the original garage door shall be fixed shut and retained as such thereafter. The building shall not be used for any commercial use or as a separate residential unit.

Condition : 8 - The hardstanding shown on drawing number 059/M/2003 shall be constructed in a permiable surface such as block paving and shall be maintained as such thereafter. The hardstanding shall not be constructed in concrete or tarmac.

Condition : 9 - It is considered that the proposed change of use from garage to habitable room and proposed parking layout would be acceptable having regard for the characteristics of the site. The proposal would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property, would not harm the living conditions of the adjoining occupiers, and would comply with the Council's parking standards in the interests of highway and pedestrian safety. The development is therefore in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) and the Residential Extensions Guidelines (October 2003)
description: Conversion of garage to habitable room.
